description: Supported catalog mutations beside preserved objects, one per step: CREATE INDEX on T.B; ALTER TABLE G ADD COLUMN; ALTER TABLE G DROP COLUMN; CREATE TABLE. Asks what changes in catalog rows, property blocks and other objects' pages at each. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it. The full catalog view is taken before the steps and after them (each a read-only open, with its own file state).
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2-pres-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
